text:
mira: FYI — noticed cross-org results showing up in the workbench when switching orgs. Happens intermittently (~5%). Repro steps below, filing because this looks like an isolation issue not a UI quirk.

josh: steps + any request ids?

mira: repro: 1) open workbench for org A 2) open saved search list 3) switch to org B via top-left switcher 4) load workbench -> sometimes you see rows from org A still in the list. No errors in console.
Example request (captured):
```
GET /api/workbench/saved-searches?page=1&per=20 HTTP/1.1
Host: console.redwood.test
Cookie: session=xxxx; org_session=org-A-abc123
X-Request-ID: r-202503010932-11a
Accept: application/json
```
Response headers: `cache-control: public, max-age=60` and no `Vary` present. Body contains results scoped to `org:A` even though UI is in `org:B`.

sam: that points at caching layer. If org is only in cookie we need `Vary: Cookie` (ugh) or put org in a header/query param that is part of the cache key. CDN currently keys on URL + Authorization header only.

carla: also saw that we store `workbench:lastView` in localStorage w/o tenant suffix. We hydrate on mount and patch the redux store. If the cached network response and localStorage combine you can get mixed state. Two possible bleed sources.

ben: quick grep of ui code: selector `getSavedSearchesForWorkspace(workspaceId)` is memoized using `workspaceId` but not `orgId`. If workspaceId can be same across orgs (we have duplicate numeric ids across shards), selector reuse will leak results. snippet: `createSelector([s => s.entities.searches, (_, wid) => wid], (searches, wid) => searches[wid])` — should include `orgId` as second key.

mira: aha. So we have at least three layers that can cause cross-org exposure: 1) CDN caching lacking org in key 2) localStorage hydration without tenant scoping 3) memoized selector keyed only by workspaceId. Any one could produce intermittent cross-org rows.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy/console@main succeeded (sha: d4c3f) — 2025-03-01T09:35:20Z

sam: short-term mitigation: purge CDN cache for `/api/workbench/*` and set `cache-control: no-cache` on saved-searches endpoint until we patch. Medium term: prefer header `X-Org-ID` in requests and update edge key to include it.

carla: short-term UI hotfix: prefix localStorage keys with `org:<orgId>:` before next canary. That should remove one source quickly. I can ship that as a tiny PR.

ben: backend change is needed too — add `orgId` to the cache key and add test in integration harness that runs two orgs in parallel to ensure no cross-pollination. I'll own selector change and add unit tests.

mira: ok. Action list: @ben patch selector + unit tests, @sam edge rule + short-term purge, @carla localStorage scoping PR, @mira file a bug and add an e2e that reproes. I'll also notify support to watch for customer reports.

josh: timeline?

mira: localStorage PR today -> canary tonight. Selector + backend change tomorrow -> canary w/ rollout. CDN purge done by @sam now?

cache-bot: PURGE /api/workbench/* — started by sam — 2025-03-01T09:36:10Z

sam: done. Purge completed across edge nodes. Added temporary response header `Cache-Control: no-cache`.

carla: sent PR  PR #4821 -> small patch, adds org prefix to `workbench:lastView`. CC @ben.

ben: opened draft PR for selector -> needs review: `ui/workbench/selectors.ts` change to include `orgId` param and tests.

mira: good. I'll create the canonical bug: `B-4123` and link the PRs. We should also add a console telemetry alert if result sets change when org switch occurs: percent mismatch > 1% triggers pager to eng-sre.

josh: sounds good. If anyone sees customer-facing incidents escalate ping oncall. :thumbsup:
